## Problem

Mosquito production habitat can occur at fine spatial scales that are hard to capture with coarse elevation or land-cover datasets.

## Data

- Drone/UAS imagery
- LiDAR point clouds
- Digital elevation models
- Field validation points
- Environmental or hydrologic context layers

## Methods

- Point-cloud classification
- DEM and hillshade generation
- Terrain derivatives such as slope, depressions, and flow accumulation
- Field validation
- Suitability or priority mapping

## Outputs

Add visuals here:

- DEM / hillshade comparison
- Point-cloud classification example
- Habitat suitability map
- Validation-point map
- Treatment-priority zones

Explain how the workflow supports targeted surveillance, treatment planning, and better understanding of habitat distribution.
